long.title: Battle of the Bulge: Every Day on the Map (Dec 1944 - Jan 1945)
long.description:
Battle of the Bulge, Day by Day, day by day on the map.

On 16 December 1944 Germany launched its last big offensive in the west, through the forests of the Ardennes. German armour broke through thin American lines, surrounded Bastogne and took St. Vith, and by 24 December the spearhead of the 2nd Panzer Division was at Foy-Notre-Dame and Celles, only a few kilometres from the Meuse. Bastogne held, Patton's Third Army broke through to it on 26 December, and the Allied counter-attack from 3 January squeezed the bulge until the First and Third Armies met at Houffalize on 16 January. By 25 January the bulge was gone.
